description: This file defines a code fix provider class for the Roslyn analyzer framework, specifically targeting incorrect attribute usage in C# code. It implements logic to register code fixes for diagnostics related to attribute misuse.

classes.name: IncorrectAttributeUseCodeFix
classes.description: A code fix provider class that offers automatic fixes for incorrect attribute usage detected by the associated analyzer.

methods.name: FixableDiagnosticIds
methods.description: Property returning the diagnostic IDs that this code fix can address.

methods.name: GetFixAllProvider
methods.description: Returns the provider that can fix all instances of the diagnostic in a batch.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers code fixes for the diagnostics found in the context.
